headline_seed: Tehran targets U.S. allies in Gulf after U.S. launched ‘large and powerful’ strikes on Iran - NBC News
draft_text:
#BreakingMews: NBC News reports U.S. strikes on Iran were followed by IRGC retaliatory attacks on U.S. bases in Iraq, UAE, Bahrain, Kuwait, and Jordan. A separate strike allegedly hit a wedding in Kuhestak, killing five.

reported by NBC News, not yet confirmed elsewhere.
